info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Methods-v1-spec
info.description: The List Payment Methods API provides a comprehensive overview of available payment methods to facilitate transactions. By calling this endpoint, consumers can retrieve data on various payment options, enabling businesses to offer flexible payment solutions to their customers. Typical users include eCommerce platforms, financial service providers, and developers looking to integrate payment functionalities into their applications. This API supports decision-making processes related to payment method selection, thereby enhancing user experience and operational efficiency.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to retrieve a list of available payment methods for processing transactions. It provides essential information about the payment options supported by the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the available payment methods for the user. Ensure that the request adheres to the specified schema to avoid errors.
